name: Automotive Lighting
description: Headlamps and signal lamps for filament lamps. Patterned lens: a paraboloid and a lens of cylinder strips through its sectors (a prism per segment) or of cells with prisms, cylinder lenses and pillows. Clear-lens headlamp: the facetted reflector of a low beam for a filament lamp (H4, H7, …) – mirror strips whose filament images touch the cut-off line, joined by walls with draft and fillets to one mouldable surface; filament images and light distribution (UN/ECE R112 test points); the light distribution also by ray tracing, with the coil modelled as a helix of wire with cooler ends, the bulb's glass and black top, the H4's shield and second coil (Path Tracer kernel).
